cand.title: OENOVITI International Symposium and General Assembly 2027
cand.excerpt: Ranks on verified event mechanism and geography; penalized where venue is committed or hotel sourcing is unconfirmed.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Agathe Lairy, University of Bordeaux ISVV project manager, is the strongest named operational introduction; the Foundation lists her against OENOVITI. Pierre-Louis Teissedre is Professor and Head of OENOVITI International, a senior network relationship contact. The Coordination Office explicitly handles event organization. Neither source establishes either person as the hotel contract signatory or the local 2027 housing buyer. Sources: https://www.fondation.univ-bordeaux.fr/projet/oenoviti/contact ; https://www.oenoviti.com/contact.html ; https://www.oenoviti.com/the-network/organization.html
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming edition within the requested horizon: 19–21 May 2027 in Nyon, Switzerland. These are activity dates explicitly published by OENOVITI and Agroscope, not article dates. Theme: Viticulture 2030: Addressing environmental, social and human challenges. Agroscope lists registration opening on 1 December 2026. Sources: https://oenoviti.com/events/385-symposium-ga-2027-switzerland.html ; https://agroscope-events.adminevents.ch/en/Veranstaltungskalender/Veranstaltungs-Details.6.html?eid=3872
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel brief: territorial fit is good for a Founex hotel serving Nyon/La Côte, but the realistic role is alternative participant/speaker accommodation, potentially ancillary small meetings or hospitality only if requested. The scientific meeting is already located at Changins; there is no evidence it needs YOTEL’s six meeting rooms or capacity. No published attendance or overnight demand supports sizing a block against the hotel’s 20–120-room commercial band. Do not propose a whole-house commitment or assume all delegates stay overnight. A practical Changins/B&B activity-departure transfer arrangement must be tested; no event shuttle serving YOTEL is published. Sources: https://agroscope-events.adminevents.ch/en/Veranstaltungskalender/Veranstaltungs-Details.6.html?eid=3872 ; https://oenoviti.com/events/385-symposium-ga-2027-switzerland.html ; https://www.yotel.com/en/hotels/yotel-geneva-lake
findings.venueCommitments: Edition-specific venue: Changins, Nyon, canton of Vaud, Switzerland — within the Nyon/La Côte primary territory, not downtown Geneva or Lausanne. Hosts: CHANGINS | Haute école de viticulture et œnologie and Agroscope. Exact building/auditorium and session-by-session allocation are not published in the accessible edition records. CHANGINS lists Route de Duillier 52, 1260 Nyon; Agroscope lists Route de Duillier 60, 1260 Nyon. These are institutional addresses, not verified 2027 room assignments. The published Changins venue is not a competing hotel. Sources: https://agroscope-events.adminevents.ch/en/Veranstaltungskalender/Veranstaltungs-Details.6.html?eid=3872 ; https://oenoviti.com/events/385-symposium-ga-2027-switzerland.html ; https://www.changins.ch/evenement/ ; https://www.agroscope.admin.ch/en/changins-en
findings.historicalRotation: Official consecutive editions: 11–15 May 2023, Kyoto/Yamanashi/Niigata, Japan; 14–15 May 2024, Asti, Italy, University of Turin partners and Uni-Astiss campus; 22–23 May 2025, Vienna, Austria, BOKU, with an associated Tulln visit; 20–22 May 2026, Porto, Portugal, University of Porto Faculty of Sciences with ENOTOUR; 19–21 May 2027, Nyon, CHANGINS/Agroscope. This establishes international host rotation, not an annual return to Nyon. See historicalEditions for edition-specific sources. Annual recurrence is explicit at https://www.oenoviti.com/events.html
findings.accommodationSourcing: Published pathway is individual direct booking, with an edition-specific recommended hotel, not unknown accommodation arrangements. OENOVITI: "OENOVITI Members will need to make their own accommodation bookings"; it recommends Hôtel B&B NYON, 20 Allée de la Petite Prairie, 1260 Nyon, and states "Activities will depart and return to this location." Corporate identification code: NOVITI27. Agroscope: "Accommodations have to be booked directly by each participant at B&B hotel, Nyon. You are, of course, free to choose alternative accommodation to suit your needs." B&B HOTEL Nyon is the only hotel named in the reviewed edition-specific guidance. No published block size, negotiated rate, room guarantee, cutoff, housing bureau or open hotel RFP was found. Recommendation plus code does not establish contracted inventory or exclusivity. Sources: https://oenoviti.com/events/385-symposium-ga-2027-switzerland.html ; https://agroscope-events.adminevents.ch/en/Veranstaltungskalender/Veranstaltungs-Details.6.html?eid=3872
findings.organizationStructure: OENOVITI is an international academic/research/industry network administered by an Executive Committee. Its Bordeaux/ISVV Coordination Office is the central event-organization contact. CHANGINS and Agroscope are the 2027 institutional hosts, not hotels or identified PCOs. ADERA handles membership fees, network finances and project-management support; this does not establish an accommodation procurement mandate. No edition-specific PCO, DMC or housing bureau is identified in reviewed guidance. Sources: https://www.oenoviti.com/the-network/organization.html ; https://agroscope-events.adminevents.ch/en/Veranstaltungskalender/Veranstaltungs-Details.6.html?eid=3872
findings.competitiveLimitations: B&B HOTEL Nyon has an edition-specific recommendation, participant code and activity departure/return advantage. This is more commercially meaningful than a generic preferred-hotel listing, but not proof of exclusive lodging or committed room inventory. No sold-out condition, capacity shortfall, overflow request or published room-night figure was found. YOTEL must compete as an explicitly permitted alternative, not claim incumbent displacement or overflow. Sources: https://oenoviti.com/events/385-symposium-ga-2027-switzerland.html ; https://agroscope-events.adminevents.ch/en/Veranstaltungskalender/Veranstaltungs-Details.6.html?eid=3872
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Approach Agathe Lairy via the OENOVITI Coordination Office, with Pierre-Louis Teissedre as the senior introduction route, preferably before the published 1 December 2026 registration opening. Acknowledge Changins as venue and B&B HOTEL Nyon as recommended activity hub. Ask for the local accommodation/logistics lead, overnight-delegate forecast, actual arrival/departure pattern, whether an optional alternative hotel can be circulated, and how guests staying elsewhere join activities. Only then quote a modest, demand-led allocation and separately priced transfers; do not describe an RFP, block need or overflow as existing. Sources supporting timing, contacts and incumbent arrangements: https://agroscope-events.adminevents.ch/en/Veranstaltungskalender/Veranstaltungs-Details.6.html?eid=3872 ; https://oenoviti.com/events/385-symposium-ga-2027-switzerland.html ; https://www.fondation.univ-bordeaux.fr/projet/oenoviti/contact ; https://www.oenoviti.com/contact.html ; https://www.oenoviti.com/the-network/organization.html
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: 2027 is the currently announced upcoming edition, not a historical opportunity. Alternative accommodation is explicitly permitted, so a limited accommodation offer is potentially accessible, subject to organizer agreement, guest choice, transport and economics. Hotel sourcing is not confirmed open; conference venue is published and recommended lodging is already named. No evidence supports an open meeting-venue sale. Source: https://agroscope-events.adminevents.ch/en/Veranstaltungskalender/Veranstaltungs-Details.6.html?eid=3872
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: build a relationship with central coordination and the local scientific hosts for future workshops and any later Swiss-hosted edition, rather than forecasting a repeat Nyon congress in 2028. Verified annual recurrence and international rotation support a network relationship strategy, not a confirmed future local room-night pipeline. No subsequent Swiss edition or return date is established by the reviewed sources. Sources: https://www.oenoviti.com/events.html ; https://www.oenoviti.com/the-network/organization.html ; https://oenoviti.com/events/385-symposium-ga-2027-switzerland.html
